data.name: Kashfi
data.gender_notes: Kashfi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kshf', meaning 'to cover, to hide, to conceal'. The name Kashfi suggests one who is hidden or concealed, or something that is kept secret. The name Kashfi carries the meaning “Hidden, Concealed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kashfi usually hope their child will grow to embody hidden, concealed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Kashfi holds a deep spiritual significance, representing the hidden aspects of one's self and the world, as well as the hidden wisdom and guidance that can be revealed through introspection and spiritual practice.
data.etymology: Kashfi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hidden, Concealed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kashfi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: كاشفي
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم كاشفي يعني المكشف أو الظاهر أو من يكشف عن الأشياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم كاشفي مشتق من الجذر العربي ك-ش-ف، ويعني الشخص الذي يكشف عن الأشياء أو يظهرها. في اللغة العربية، الكشف يعني الإظهار أو التبيان. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَإِذَا عَينُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدَةٌ' ( الفرقان 22 )، حيث يشير إلى كشف الغطاء أو الستر.

in_urdu.name: کاشفی
in_urdu.meaning: کاشفی نام کا مطلب ہے ظاہر کرنے والا یا مکشوف کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: کاشفی نام عربی جڑ ک-ش-ف سے ماخوذ ہے، جو ظاہر کرنے یا کشف کرنے کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو چھپے ہوئے حقائق کو ظاہر کرتا ہے یا انکشاف کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعے روایتی طور پر استعمال ہوتا رہا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔

in_hindi.name: काशफी
in_hindi.meaning: काशफी नाम का अर्थ है प्रकट करने वाला या जाहिर करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: काशफी नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल क-श-फ से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकट करना या जाहिर करना। हिंदी में, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो छुपे हुए तथ्यों को प्रकट करता है या अनावरण करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पारंपरिक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता रहा है, खासकर भारत में।

in_pashto.name: کاشفي
in_pashto.meaning: کاشفي نوم د ښکاره کوونکي يا مکشف کوونکي معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: کاشفي نوم د عربي جڑ ک-ش-ف څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ښکاره کولو يا کشف کولو معنی لري. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چې پټ حقايق ښکاره کوي يا انکشاف کوي. دا نوم په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې د مسلمانانو لخوا دودیز استعمال شوی دی.

in_english.name: Kashfi
in_english.meaning: Kashfi means revealer or one who discloses
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kashfi originates from the Arabic root k-sh-f, which means to reveal or disclose. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies someone who uncovers hidden truths or exposes facts. The root k-sh-f is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing revelation and disclosure. Historically, the name Kashfi has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual insight and truth-revealing qualities.

pronunciation.pashto: کاشفي د کاش-في په تلفظ کيږي

It is a title given to Sufi Scholars and Poets who have attained a high level of spiritual and mystical understanding but choose to keep their knowledge and insights hidden or concealed from the world. The name is also given to beautiful and enchanting women whose beauty is a well-kept secret.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kashfi holds a significant spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It signifies the inner journey towards self-realization and the search for divine knowledge that is hidden from the ordinary world. The name represents the idea of self-discovery and the understanding that true wisdom and knowledge is not something that can be easily acquired or shown off to the world. It symbolizes the importance of keeping one's inner spiritual journey private and focused on personal growth rather than seeking external validation or recognition.

historical_references.reference: Kashfi al-Asma' wa-l-Lughat al-Ta'nia (Comprehensive Dictionary of Islamic Terminology) by Allamah Kashfi
historical_references.context: A Persian scholar and theologian, Allamah Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Qazwini al-Kashfi, is renowned for his comprehensive dictionary of Islamic terminology, Kashfi al-Asma' wa-l-Lughat al-Ta'nia. This work, which is considered a major reference in Islamic studies, was completed in the 14th century.

historical_references.reference: Sayr al-Anam wa-Tarikh al-Hayam (Journey of the Soul and History of the World) by Qazi Nasiruddin Muhammad Kashfi
historical_references.context: Qazi Nasiruddin Muhammad Kashfi, also known as Kashfi, was a 17th-century historian and poet. His major work, Sayr al-Anam wa-Tarikh al-Hayam (Journey of the Soul and History of the World), is a comprehensive history of the Islamic world from the creation of Adam until the Safavid Empire in the early 17th century.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Kashfi' in modern context refers to an individual or a platform that focuses on spiritual growth, self-discovery, mental health and well-being, and knowledge seeking.
